verdict.rationale: Render's marketing says you can "iterate quickly with ephemeral previews of your entire application architecture for every change," which matches automatic per-PR preview environments. The repo-connected push-to-deploy flow supports this. The evidence is a single high-level marketing line that never mentions pull requests or preview URLs explicitly. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on PR-triggered previews and their generated URLs, configuration details (e.g., Blueprint preview settings, expiry), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
